transport: UTF-8 JSON-lines: the verifier sends one complete-set request followed by EOF. solution/main.py emits exactly one newline-terminated finite JSON response and exits. Existing for-line persistent entries remain compatible. Extra stdout is invalid; stderr is bounded diagnostics.

request.records: All final records with sample_id, group_id, atomic_symbols, coordinates_angstrom, total_charge, low_spin_multiplicity, high_spin_multiplicity; no target or ground-state label.

execution: Offline unprivileged Python subprocess in the verifier container; read-only frozen solution and writable temporary working directory. The interface supplies structures but no references. The solution shares the scorer filesystem/user; no chroot, separate UID, seccomp or label-access isolation is promised. Intended for trusted internal submissions. CPU Python 3.11; operator supplies the numerical runtime.
completeness: Predict all 103 final IDs exactly once. Missing, duplicate, unknown IDs and nonfinite/boolean values invalidate the submission. Record MAE is primary; formula-group summaries are diagnostics.
